subject: Java Programming (Core Java)
tools: BlueJ / Eclipse / IntelliJ IDEA / VS Code

projects.title: High-Performance CSV Line Assembler with Pre-Sized Capacity
projects.description: Construct a high-speed CSV record serializer that converts an array of student records into comma-separated rows. To avoid multiple internal array resizes and memory reallocation, pre-size the StringBuilder with an estimated capacity and append fields fluently.
projects.exampleText: Serialize trainee record: id=101, name="Rahul Roy", gpa=8.95, city="Barrackpore"
projects.exampleOutput:
Generated CSV Row:
101,Rahul Roy,8.95,Barrackpore
Buffer Initial Capacity: 64
Final Buffer Length: 29
projects.learningOutcome: Learn to pre-size StringBuilder instances to eliminate memory reallocation overhead during batch text serialization.

projects.title: Thread-Safe Concurrent Audit Log Buffer using StringBuffer
projects.description: Simulate a financial transaction audit logger where multiple concurrent worker threads append timestamped transaction messages to the same shared buffer. Use StringBuffer to ensure thread safety without character interleaving or lost data.
projects.exampleText: Launch 3 worker threads writing 2 log events each to a shared StringBuffer
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Shared Audit Log ---
[Thread-1] Transaction TXN-101 Verified
[Thread-2] Transaction TXN-102 Verified
[Thread-3] Transaction TXN-103 Verified
[Thread-1] Transaction TXN-104 Verified
[Thread-2] Transaction TXN-105 Verified
[Thread-3] Transaction TXN-106 Verified
Total Log Entries: 6
projects.learningOutcome: Master multi-threaded shared buffer synchronization using StringBuffer's intrinsic monitor locks.

projects.title: Internal Capacity Growth & Dynamic Formula Inspector
projects.description: Demonstrate the internal array expansion formula of StringBuilder. Start with a default empty builder (16 chars), append text exceeding the boundary, and programmatically inspect how the capacity transitions using ((oldCapacity * 2) + 2).
projects.exampleText: Start with new StringBuilder(), check capacity at 0, 16, 17, and 35 characters
projects.exampleOutput:
Step 0 (Initial)  : Length = 0,  Capacity = 16
Step 1 (16 chars) : Length = 16, Capacity = 16
Step 2 (17 chars) : Length = 17, Capacity = 34 (Formula: (16*2)+2 = 34)
Step 3 (35 chars) : Length = 35, Capacity = 70 (Formula: (34*2)+2 = 70)
projects.learningOutcome: Verify Java's geometric buffer reallocation mechanics and compute capacity changes programmatically.

projects.title: Enterprise Financial Invoice & Receipt Formatter using String.format()
projects.description: Build an enterprise receipt printing utility that accepts line items with unit prices, calculates taxes and totals, and outputs a aligned ASCII receipt with proper decimal precision and comma groupings.
projects.exampleText: Generate receipt for Laptop (Rs 65,000.00), Mouse (Rs 1,250.50), GST (18%)
projects.learningOutcome: Produce professional financial and accounting receipts using precise string format specifiers and alignment flags.

projects.title: Dynamic SQL Query Generator with Fluent Filtering Clauses
projects.description: Implement a dynamic SQL query builder class that constructs SELECT queries with optional WHERE predicates (e.g. city, minimum GPA, active status) fluently. Ensure the builder cleanly handles whether the 'WHERE' keyword is needed without leaving dangling 'AND' clauses.
projects.exampleText: Build query for table "trainees", filter city="Barrackpore", minGpa=8.5, activeOnly=true
projects.exampleOutput:
Generated SQL:
SELECT id, name, gpa, hub FROM trainees WHERE hub = 'Barrackpore' AND gpa >= 8.50 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY gpa DESC;
projects.learningOutcome: Design fluent builder APIs using StringBuilder to assemble dynamic SQL statements safely.

projects.title: Modern REST API JSON Payload Generator using Java 15 Text Blocks
projects.description: Construct a REST API JSON response generator using modern multi-line Text Blocks and fluent .formatted() interpolation. Compare how Text Blocks eliminate ugly backslash escaping (\"key\") in JSON strings.
projects.exampleText: Generate response for status="SUCCESS", code=200, academy="Coder & AccoTax", studentCount=42
projects.learningOutcome: Write readable JSON microservice payloads using Java 15+ Text Blocks and .formatted() interpolation.

projects.title: Markdown-to-HTML Parser and Content Formatter using StringBuilder
projects.description: Build a lightweight Markdown-to-HTML parser. Use StringBuilder to process markdown input line-by-line, converting headers (#, ##), bold text (**text**), italics (*text*), and list bullets (-) into valid HTML markup.
projects.exampleText: Parse "# Welcome to Java\n- Learn **StringBuilder**\n- Master *Formatting*"
projects.exampleOutput:
Welcome to Java

  • Learn StringBuilder
  • Master Formatting
projects.learningOutcome: Implement text transformation engines by combining StringBuilder line aggregation with token parsing.

projects.title: High-Speed Palindrome & Anagram Verifier using StringBuilder.reverse()
projects.description: Construct an efficient palindrome detection routine using StringBuilder.reverse(). Cleanse the input string of punctuation and spaces, copy it into a StringBuilder, reverse it in-place with zero extra heap garbage, and compare with the cleaned text.
projects.exampleText: Test "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!" and "Madam, I'm Adam"
projects.exampleOutput:
Original Text: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!
Cleaned Text : amanaplanacanalpanama
Reversed Text: amanaplanacanalpanama
Is Palindrome: true
projects.learningOutcome: Utilize StringBuilder.reverse() for high-performance in-place character transformations.

projects.title: Sensitive PII Masking Utility using StringBuilder.replace()
projects.description: Implement a sensitive data sanitizer that masks credit card numbers (showing only the last 4 digits) and Aadhaar numbers (showing only the last 4 digits) by directly modifying the characters in-place using StringBuilder.replace().
projects.learningOutcome: Apply StringBuilder in-place range replacements for regulatory privacy masking.

projects.title: URL Query Parameter Serializer with Fluent Encoding
projects.description: Create a fluent URL query parameter builder that accepts key-value pairs, encodes values safely, and appends the proper '?' and '&' delimiters without leaving trailing ampersands.
projects.exampleText: Base URL: "https://api.coderaccotax.com/search", params: query="Java Core", hub="Barrackpore", page=1
projects.exampleOutput:
Constructed URL:
https://api.coderaccotax.com/search?query=Java+Core&hub=Barrackpore&page=1
projects.learningOutcome: Construct clean, robust REST request URLs using state-aware StringBuilder chaining.

projects.title: Multi-Row Batch SQL INSERT Generator with setLength() Trimming
projects.description: Generate high-throughput multi-row batch SQL INSERT statements (e.g. INSERT INTO trainees (id, name, score) VALUES (1, 'A', 90), (2, 'B', 85)...). Use StringBuilder.setLength() to trim off the trailing comma efficiently before appending the final semicolon.
projects.exampleText: Generate batch insert for 3 trainees into table "trainees"
projects.exampleOutput:
Generated Batch Statement:
INSERT INTO trainees (id, name, score) VALUES
  (101, 'Aheli Sen', 92.50),
  (102, 'Rohan Das', 88.00),
  (103, 'Priya Paul', 95.75);
projects.learningOutcome: Use StringBuilder.setLength() for instantaneous trailing delimiter truncation in enterprise SQL scripts.

projects.title: Hexadecimal & Binary Memory Dump Formatter
concepts: Building Wireshark / Hex Editor style memory views
projects.description: Create a binary hex-dumper similar to Linux xxd or Wireshark. Convert an array of raw bytes into a formatted multi-column display showing memory offset, hex representation (%02X), and printable ASCII characters.
projects.exampleText: Dump string bytes of "Hello, Barrackpore!"
projects.learningOutcome: Format raw binary and byte streams into professional hex inspector views using %02X specifiers.

projects.title: Interactive ASCII Data Table Generator with Dynamic Column Widths
projects.description: Construct an automated ASCII table generator. Given arbitrary headers and 2D row data, calculate the maximum width of each column and dynamically generate clean ASCII grid borders with left and right aligned data.
projects.exampleText: Headers: ["ID", "STUDENT NAME", "GRADE", "CITY"], Rows: 3 trainee records
projects.learningOutcome: Build flexible, dynamic CLI data tables using calculated width format strings.

projects.title: HTML Email Notification Template Engine using Java 15 Text Blocks
projects.description: Develop an enterprise transactional email builder for student course admissions. Use multi-line Text Blocks to maintain clean HTML layout and style tags, and interpolate the student's name, course, batch date, and portal link via .formatted().
projects.exampleText: Generate welcome email for "Debolina Paul", Course: "Core Java Mastery", Batch: "15-Oct-2026"
projects.exampleOutput:
Welcome to Coder & AccoTax, Debolina Paul!

Your enrollment in Core Java Mastery is confirmed for 15-Oct-2026.

Access Learning Portal
projects.learningOutcome: Construct elegant multi-line HTML emails natively in Java without external templating dependencies.

projects.title: Comprehensive Benchmark: String (+) vs StringBuilder vs StringBuffer
projects.description: Construct a reproducible performance micro-benchmark that appends 30,000 iterations using: 1) String with '+' concatenation, 2) StringBuilder, and 3) StringBuffer. Measure execution time in milliseconds and print a comparative summary table.
projects.exampleText: Execute 30,000 append iterations across all 3 textual mechanisms
projects.exampleOutput:
Benchmark Results (30,000 iterations):
1. String (+) Concatenation : ~850 ms  [High GC Churn, O(N^2)]
2. StringBuilder (Mutable)  : ~2 ms    [Fastest, Zero Lock, O(N)]
3. StringBuffer (Sync)      : ~4 ms    [Thread-Safe Lock Cost, O(N)]
Speedup: StringBuilder is over 400x faster than String (+)!
projects.learningOutcome: Quantify real-world performance differences and algorithmic complexity between Java's string implementations.

projects.title: DNA Genetic Sequence Mutation & Reverse Complement Engine
projects.description: In bioinformatics, calculating the reverse complement of a DNA strand is a standard operation. Create an engine using StringBuilder to replace nucleotides with their complements (A<->T, C<->G) in-place and reverse the entire strand.
projects.exampleText: Input DNA strand: "ATGCGATCGAAT"
projects.exampleOutput:
Original Strand   : ATGCGATCGAAT
Complement Strand : TACGCTAGCTTA
Reverse Complement: ATTCGATCGCAT
projects.learningOutcome: Utilize setCharAt() and reverse() for zero-copy character transformations in bioinformatics algorithms.

projects.title: Text Block Indentation Normalizer & Line Continuation Processor
projects.description: Demonstrate the compiler features of Java 15 Text Blocks: incidental whitespace stripping, splitting long paragraphs across code lines using the trailing backslash (\) without creating newline characters, and preserving trailing spaces using \s.
projects.exampleText: Compare multi-line text block with and without line continuations
projects.exampleOutput:
Line Continuation Output:
This is a very long sentence that is written across three physical lines of Java code but renders as a single uninterrupted sentence without line breaks!

Preserved Trailing Whitespace:
[Line with 4 spaces]    |
projects.learningOutcome: Master Java Text Block whitespace semantics, escape translations, and line continuation backslashes.

projects.title: Automated Java POJO Class Scaffold & Code Generator
projects.description: Build an automated code generator that accepts a class name and list of fields, and generates complete, compilable Java source code containing private fields, constructor, getters, setters, and toString().
projects.exampleText: Generate POJO class "Trainee" with fields: ["int id", "String name", "double score"]
projects.learningOutcome: Construct enterprise code generators by harmonizing Text Block skeletons with dynamic StringBuilder components.

projects.title: Buffer Pre-Sizing Optimizer & trimToSize() Memory Manager
projects.description: Demonstrate memory optimization in high-volume microservices. Use ensureCapacity() to accommodate large bursts of text, and once processing completes, invoke trimToSize() to shrink the backing array down to exact character count, releasing excess heap memory.
projects.exampleText: Allocate buffer with capacity 1000, write 50 characters, call trimToSize()
projects.exampleOutput:
Initial Pre-Sized Capacity: 1000
After Writing 50 chars    : Length = 50, Capacity = 1000 (950 unused chars in Heap!)
After calling trimToSize(): Length = 50, Capacity = 50   (Excess memory freed!)
projects.learningOutcome: Manage JVM heap consumption effectively using ensureCapacity() and trimToSize().

projects.title: Concurrent Thread-Safe Telemetry & Metrics Ring Buffer
projects.description: Build an in-memory telemetry buffer using StringBuffer where multiple simulated API gateway threads simultaneously log HTTP status codes and response times. Extract thread-safe periodic snapshots for reporting without halting incoming traffic.
projects.exampleText: 4 producer threads recording status codes into shared telemetry buffer
projects.exampleOutput:
--- Telemetry Snapshot ---
[STATUS: 200, LATENCY: 12ms]
[STATUS: 200, LATENCY: 18ms]
[STATUS: 500, LATENCY: 45ms]
[STATUS: 200, LATENCY: 15ms]
Total Metrics Recorded: 4
projects.learningOutcome: Design thread-safe in-memory metric collectors with atomic snapshot and reset capabilities.

projects.title: Roman Numeral to Integer & Integer to Roman Converter
projects.description: Implement a bidirectional Roman Numeral conversion utility. Use a StringBuilder to assemble the Roman numeral string efficiently by iteratively appending matched numeral symbols (M, CM, D, CD, C, XC, L, XL, X, IX, V, IV, I) in descending value order.
projects.exampleText: Convert 1994, 2026, 49 into Roman numerals
projects.exampleOutput:
Integer: 1994 -> Roman: MCMXCIV
Integer: 2026 -> Roman: MMXXVI
Integer: 49   -> Roman: XLIX
projects.learningOutcome: Apply StringBuilder in algorithmic greedy-matching number systems and symbol decoders.

projects.title: Multi-Line Configuration File Parser & INI/YAML Formatter
projects.description: Construct an application configuration generator that serializes database, server, and security properties into a standardized properties/YAML file layout. Utilize Text Blocks for structural comments and StringBuilder with formatting flags for clean key-value column alignment.
projects.exampleText: Format application properties: db.host, db.port, db.user, server.port, app.env
projects.exampleOutput:
# ==========================================================
# ENTERPRISE MICROSERVICE APPLICATION CONFIGURATION
# HUB: Barrackpore | Academic: Coder & AccoTax
# ==========================================================

app.environment      = PRODUCTION
server.port          = 8080
database.host        = db.cluster.coderaccotax.internal
database.port        = 5432
database.username    = svc_trainee_master
projects.learningOutcome: Synthesize Text Blocks and formatted StringBuilders to generate enterprise configuration files.
